clauses.text: REGULAR CLASS. Regular class is a class prescribed in the curriculum during the semester/term it is offered, regardless of size.

SPECIAL CLASS. Special class is a class which is not prescribed in the curriculum during a given semester/term but is requested by a student/s to be offered during the semester/term, subject to the availability of faculty and a special class fee, corresponding to the number of lecture/laboratory units. Special class must have a maximum of fifteen (15) students. Special class assessment shall be paid to the University Cashier. All special classes must observe the regular number of class hours prescribed for the subject.
conditions: subject to the availability of faculty and a special class fee

clauses.text: An off-semester subject may still be offered as a regular class provided there are at least 35 students for lecture and 25 students for laboratory who will enroll in the subject and a faculty is available to teach the subject.
conditions: at least 35 students for lecture and 25 students for laboratory
a faculty is available to teach the subject

clauses.text: SUMMER LOAD. The normal load for the summer term shall be nine (9) units for both the undergraduate and graduate students. Graduating undergraduate students may, however, be allowed a higher load but not to exceed twelve (12) units, subject to prior approval of the Dean.
